description:
This immaculate ground floor flat offers an excellent opportunity to acquire a well-presented and spacious one-bedroom home in the heart of Aberdeen. The property is characterised by its well-maintained interior and thoughtfully designed living spaces, making it well-suited to a range of buyers seeking comfort and convenience in a desirable locale.  

The accommodation comprises a generous living room, providing a warm and welcoming atmosphere with ample space for relaxation and entertaining guests. The kitchen offers potential for casual dining, allowing for comfortable meal preparation. The full bathroom presents a clean and functional design, while the double bedroom features excellent storage solutions to support an organised lifestyle.

 

Gas central heating ensures the property remains comfortable throughout the seasons. Additional features include access to a shared garden, offering a tranquil outdoor space, and the benefit of street parking for residents and visitors.

 

 

Ashvale Place is just off Holburn Street which is a highly regarded area within Aberdeen, known for its combination of tranquillity and central convenience. Residents enjoy proximity to a wide range of amenities including shops, cafes, and transport links, making daily life both practical and enjoyable. The local community is well-established, and provide opportunities for leisure and recreation in a pleasant urban environment. This location enables easy access to the city centre while maintaining a peaceful, established and traditional residential setting.  The property benefits from good transport links to both universities and the Aberdeen Royal Infirmary campus making this ideal for students, and professionals alike.

 

NOTE HOME REPORT - The home report is available to view on the Northwood website portal (northwooduk.com/aberdeen)- within the listing and select "View home report".

 

Viewings are highly recommended to appreciate this well appointed apartment in ready to move in condition and providing easy access to local amenities. Please contact Northwood Aberdeen to arrange a viewing.

 EPC rating: D. Tenure: Freehold,
